$comment: Short list for the time-zone Select (B13, C6). The Select lists the course's zone, the viewer's detected zone, then 'first' and 'short' — each zone once — and last 'Diğer…', which opens every IANA zone Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone') returns. A zone's name in copy ('21:00 İstanbul') is its city from 'cities'. DRAFT — where talebe live is the owner's data; the diaspora list is not verified. Rules: MDS-NUM-01.

fields.first: the zone the short list starts with
fields.short: the rest of the short list, in order
fields.cities: the Turkish city name for each listed zone, used in the option label and in copy
fields.otherLabel: the last option, which opens the full list
